CFML Language Reference: Functions

StructFindKey

Searches a structure, and every structure and array nested inside it, for keys named key. Use it on deep structures such as a deserialized WDDX packet, where you do not know at what level a key lives.

Category

Structure functions

Syntax

StructFindKey(top, key [, scope])

Parameters

top
The structure to search.
key
The key name to look for (case-insensitive).
scope
"one" (the default) stops at the first match; "all" returns every match.

Returns

An array of structures, one per match, each with the keys Value (the value of the key), Path (where it was found, such as .STAFF[2].NAME) and Owner (the structure that holds the key).

Usage

The search runs depth first, in the order the keys were added.

Note  New in KoldFusion 4.5.1 SP2.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Company = StructNew()>
<CFSET Company.Name = "Gibson Mainframe Co.">
<CFSET Company.Staff = ArrayNew(1)>
<CFSET Company.Staff[1] = StructNew()>
<CFSET Company.Staff[1].Name = "Carol Reardon">
<CFSET Company.Staff[2] = StructNew()>
<CFSET Company.Staff[2].Name = "Jack Lindqvist">
<CFSET Found = StructFindKey(Company, "Name", "all")>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>#ArrayLen(Found)# keys called Name:</P>
<UL>
<CFLOOP FROM="1" TO="#ArrayLen(Found)#" INDEX="i">
  <LI>#Found[i].Path# = #Found[i].Value#
</CFLOOP>
</UL>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

StructFindValue, StructFind, StructKeyExists, StructSort
